series.name: Table C — InfiniSolar VII WP (mirror)
series.notes: Warning W19 printed as BP on WP panel. Mirror-hosted → medium.

title.en: Battery is not connected (WP panel label)

meaning.en: Same event as Table B W19 / Table A blank row; WP firmware labels it 'BP'.
meaning.ur: Table B W19 / Table A ke blank row jaisi hi haalat; WP firmware isay 'BP' kehta hai.

causes.en: Battery not connected / wiring or fuse fault.
causes.ur: battery munsalik nahin / wiring ya fuse

source.title: InfiniSolar VII WP manual (220v.com.ua mirror of Voltronic PDF)

notes.en: Mirror-hosted OEM PDF → medium. Store literally as code 'BP' (string, not numeric). Platform reference entry (table source SRC-VIIWP). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: Mirror-hosted OEM PDF → medium. Code 'BP' ko literally store karein (string hai, numeric nahin). Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-VIIWP). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Icon flashing (battery icon); no beep documented on WP.
